meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, DBIE, via the Reserve Bank Innovation Hub's data service
meta.revisionPolicy: Bank-wise figures are the banks' own returns as the RBI publishes them and are not revised once printed; the Outlook's latest March is provisional and is replaced by the next edition's figure. Mergers are disclosed on the acquirer, never joined.
meta.coverage: Performance ratios of every bank group (public sector, private sector, foreign, small finance, local area) and all scheduled commercial banks, every quarter
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 1221 (table 5, "Performance Indicators"), via the Reserve Bank Innovation Hub's data service, as published from the RBI's off-site returns. Amounts are printed in thousands of rupees (the header says crore; see the adapter) and baked in ₹ crore; ratios in per cent. Operations: domestic (offices in India), overseas (offices abroad), global (both). A series the RBI prints as zero throughout (overseas operations of a bank with none) is left out. Banks are named as the RBI names them; a renamed bank is one series, a merged bank's series ends and the acquirer's carries on, with the merger in its mergerNote.
